description: tonyd2wild's llm-eyes: Qwen3.5-0.8B (Unsloth Dynamic UD-Q8_K_XL GGUF plus the F16 vision projector) served by llama.cpp CUDA on one Spark as a small OpenAI-compatible image-captioning endpoint, so text-only models can be given a description of an image. Basis: tonyd2wild/2Wild-Vision-Mode (MIT), whose Spark backend runs llama-server with a CUDA build the user compiles; this recipe builds llama.cpp b11243 (commit fc07d781, ggml-org) for GB10 at a pinned commit instead. The default context and slot count (262144 tokens, 4 slots) are llama.cpp's automatic defaults, which upstream leaves unset. Upstream's bridge scripts (see.py, webcam_loop.py) are client-side and not packaged. Vonk physical Spark acceptance is pending and the sm_121 build has not been run.
title: Qwen3.5 0.8B vision helper llama.cpp one Spark
